useRefreshTokenForClientCredentialsGrant.previous_source: If this is on, a refresh_token will be created and added to the token response if the client_credentials grant is used. The OAuth 2.0 RFC6749 Section 4.4.3 states that a refresh_token should not be generated when client_credentials grant is used. If this is off then no refresh_token will be generated and the associated user session will be removed.
